question: Which of the following technologies was used for the first time in February 2022 by astronomers from NCRA-TIFR to map the distribution of atomic hydrogen gas in the galaxy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Giant Meter wave Radio Telescope (GMRT)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Giant Metre wave Radio Telescope (GMRT) **is a technology that was used for the** first time in February 2022**
 
• By astronomers from **NCRA-TIFR **to map the distribution of atomic** hydrogen gas in the galaxy.**
 
• **GMRT is an array of 30 radio telescopes, each 45 m in diameter.**
 
• GMRT is spread over an area of **30 square kilometres, located near Pune, India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Helioswarm**

 
 
• **​**Helioswarm is a proposed** European Space Agency (ESA) **mission to study the dynamics of the solar corona and the solar wind.
 
• The mission would involve a** fleet of small, identical spacecraft that would fly in formation through the solar wind to study the small-scale structures and processes that drive the solar wind**.
 
• The mission is expected to provide new insights into how the Sun's atmosphere is heated and how the solar wind is accelerated.​
 
 
 
• **Multislit Solar Explorer (MUSE)**
 
 
• **​Multislit Solar Explorer (MUSE) is a proposed space mission** that aims to study the dynamics of the solar atmosphere.
 
• The mission would use a multi-slit spectrograph to** take high-resolution images of the solar atmosphere and measure the velocities and temperatures of the gases in the solar atmosphere.**
 
• This would provide new insights into the processes that drive the **solar wind and the heating of the solar atmosphere.** MUSE would also be able to study the solar magnetic field, which plays a key role in many solar phenomena, such as solar flares and coronal mass ejections.
